{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check for re-testing (sample_seq > 1)
retest_count = (df['sample_seq'] > 1).sum()
print(f"Number of re-tests (sample_seq > 1): {retest_count}")

# Check if any patient has multiple sample_seq entries
patient_sample_seq_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {patient_sample_seq_counts.max()}")
print(f"Patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(patient_sample_seq_counts[patient_sample_seq_counts > 1])}")

# Summary of findings
note_finding(
    'Duplicated patient_id',
    f"{len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()} duplicate patient_id entries found. {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()} rows are duplicates.",
    implication="Rows are not one-per-patient. Must deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient."
)

note_finding(
    'Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline',
    f"{sentinel_count} rows have biomarker_baseline == -999. These are QC failures, not valid measurements.",
    implication="Must exclude these rows from any baseline computation."
)

note_finding(
    'Re-tested patients',
    f"{retest_count} rows have sample_seq > 1. {len(patient_sample_seq_counts[patient_sample_seq_counts > 1])} patients were re-tested.",
    implication="Must deduplicate by keeping the highest sample_seq row per patient."
)

# Now deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
# First, filter out sentinel values in baseline
filtered_df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Then, deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient
deduplicated_df = filtered_df.loc[filtered_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final count
print(f"Final number of unique patients after deduplication: {len(deduplicated_df)}")"}
